title: Cable Woodchop
summary: A standing diagonal cable chop for the obliques.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for obliques (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly obliques total.
Library rating 0.4 for abs (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Set a cable high, stand side-on and grab the handle with both hands.
Pull it down and across your body to the opposite hip, rotating through your torso.
Return slowly along the same diagonal.

form_cues.cue: Rotate down and across your body
Pivot your back foot so your hips can turn with you.

mistakes.text: Pulling with the arms instead of rotating.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Better isolation, Lower loading potential.
Swap sheet: Less stable, One side at a time, More systemic fatigue.
